Mira: Quick heads-up 0— we hit 42,000,000 requests this month! :tada: :confetti_ball:

Nina: should we celebrate in person? small thing friday 4pm with snacks and pics? :camera:

Mira: vote time 1: react with :dumpling: or :cupcake: or both if you want both.
Jon: :dumpling: all the way
Priya: :cupcake: but fine i'll accept both :grin:
DevBot: Deploy bot: FYI no infra changes scheduled Fri 15:00-17:00 for celebration window.
Nina: awesome, thanks @DevBot. can someone grab confetti cannons from storage? i'll clean up after, promise :sweat_smile:

Mira: i'll start: "Always Be My Baby" 
by Mariah Carey :notes:
Jon: "Uptown Funk" added 
(youre welcome) :musical_note:
